quote: Problem 7.4.2 in Kitaev-Lozin's 'Words and Graphs' (2015) asks about the representation number of crown graphs, the extremal floor(n/2) question
note: The foundational concept of word-representable graphs was introduced by Kitaev in 2004, and systematically developed in Kitaev and Pyatkin (2008). The specific floor(n/2) extremal question asking whether any graph requires more than floor(n/2) copies of each letter was formalized as Problem 7.4.2 in the 2015 Springer book 'Words and Graphs' by Kitaev and Lozin.
